protocol: 3 neurons, 1 Wicks chemical edge, 4 trials x 20 frames, no pre-stim encoder; true parameters fixed in simulation, 300 SVI steps, AutoDiagonalNormal.
conclusion: Even in a tiny identifiable-in-principle model, SVI does not recover the true conductance/kinetics combination: g_max is 5x low, tau_ca 27% low, k_off 11% low, while V_th is near the prior median. This is direct evidence for compensation/identifiability problems and a reason to add hierarchical/structured priors rather than interpreting individual fitted parameters.
